name: Star Fall
source:
Andromeda is an ordinary girl going to an ordinary high school in the ordinary small town of Star Fall. Her life changes forever when she encounters a pair of mysterious brothers with strange powers — the pragmatic and stoic Pollux, and the charming but diabolical Castor.

Wait what do you mean the developer forgot to replace the placeholder assets—
